integrity: The complete finite census, simplicial free-face collapse sequence, spanning-tree fundamental-group certificate, and mod-two ranks are recomputed by the embedded standard-library script; the integral homotopy conclusion follows from a mathematical proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the full strong discrete Morse matching complex of the eight-vertex Q3 is classified. General cube graphs, all ordinary Morse complexes and torsion beyond this object are not addressed. Novelty search cannot be exhaustive.
title: The full strong Morse matching complex of the three-cube is a wedge of 31 two-spheres
